scope: Model/provider, routing/admission/metering, MCP, marketplace/skills, memory, reminders, public search, image bridge. Fixture results do not certify live deployment.
cellFormat: Each operation has exactly five cells in dimensions order. Evidence IDs identify passed fixture assertions; FAIL IDs identify reproducible defects; U codes identify exact missing validation, not a pass.

unverifiedReasons.U-C: No dedicated simultaneous-operation fixture for this exact operation.
unverifiedReasons.U-R: No dedicated restart/crash or injected-failure recovery fixture for this exact operation.
unverifiedReasons.U-I: No independent cross-home/session/tenant fixture for this exact operation.
unverifiedReasons.U-N: Source inventoried; no complete successful behavior fixture for this exact operation.
unverifiedReasons.U-F: Source inventoried; failure branches not exhaustively injected for this exact operation.
unverifiedReasons.U-UI: Renderer contract/static checks only; no live GUI interaction or visual verification in this task.
unverifiedReasons.U-CORE: Owned wrapper and installed upstream source inspected, but this upstream operation has no direct behavior fixture here.
unverifiedReasons.ENV-PROVIDER: Real account/OAuth/paid provider transactions prohibited in this delegated audit; synthetic routes and fake fetch used instead.
unverifiedReasons.ENV-INSTALL: Real npm/git/plugin lifecycle execution prohibited; only fake subprocess or inert temporary skill files used.
unverifiedReasons.ENV-MEMORY: Real user memory store is excluded, including any investigation of the independent outcome-unknown incident.
unverifiedReasons.ENV-IMAGE: Real Codex image generation is separately billed/outside audit authorization; fake subprocess only.
unverifiedReasons.UNSUPPORTED: No such implementation in this version; not counted as verified capability.
unverifiedReasons.NA: Dimension not meaningful for a pure deterministic transformation; not a pass.
